verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no scheduled runs, event or CI triggers, or always-on background agents that maintain and fix software on their own. Goal-based multi-step execution and remote invocation via WeChat, Feishu or Telegram are adjacent features: the remote invocation is a user-initiated chat command, not an autonomous schedule or trigger, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can set up always-on agents that run on schedules or triggers to maintain and fix my software autonomously
